CYTOGENETICS LABORATORY REPORT
[redacted location] Medical Center
Department of Clinical Genetics

Patient: [redacted name]
MRN: [redacted ID]
DOB: [redacted date]
Specimen ID: [redacted ID]
Physician: Dr. [redacted name]

SPECIMEN TYPE: Peripheral blood
DATE COLLECTED: [redacted date]
DATE RECEIVED: [redacted date]
DATE REPORTED: [redacted date]

CLINICAL INDICATION
Follow-up to rapid aneuploidy PCR screening. Rule out Down syndrome.

TEST PERFORMED
Conventional cytogenetic analysis
G-banded karyotype at 400-450 band resolution

RESULT
Karyotype: 46,XX

No evidence of trisomy 21 or other numerical abnormalities detected.
No major structural chromosomal rearrangements identified.

TECHNICAL DETAILS
20 metaphases analyzed from phytohemagglutinin-stimulated peripheral blood lymphocyte cultures.
Banding resolution adequate for detection of numerical abnormalities and major structural rearrangements.
Analysis quality sufficient for excluding trisomy 21 and other common aneuploidies.

INTERPRETATION
Normal female karyotype. This result excludes Down syndrome (trisomy 21) and other detectable chromosomal abnormalities at the resolution achieved. This finding is consistent with the normal result obtained from the previous rapid aneuploidy PCR analysis performed on [redacted date].

LIMITATIONS
This analysis cannot detect balanced rearrangements below the resolution limit, low-level mosaicism (<10%), or single gene mutations.

Reported by: [redacted name], PhD, FACMG
Laboratory Director
